steps.title: Unbiased variance
steps.idea: Dividing by n underestimates the variance; dividing by n − 1 removes the bias.

steps.title: Confidence interval for the mean
steps.idea: An interval built from the sample covers the true mean in a stated share of repeated samples.

steps.title: Homogeneity of two series
steps.idea: Two series of trials give frequencies m₁/n₁ and m₂/n₂. Are they samples of one probability p? Pool them and compare the difference with its standard error.
formula: z = (m₁/n₁ − m₂/n₂) / √(p̂(1 − p̂)(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)),  p̂ = (m₁ + m₂)/(n₁ + n₂)
